Maybe instead of manually dialing that in, it could just be a math function that creates a conversion factor for front-pagedness. For example, say you're subscribed to three subs, one is super-popular, one of moderate popularity, and one oddball sub with only a handful of subscribers. The highest upvoated post on each sub has 1000 pts, 100 pts, and 10 pts. To generate the front page, it would divide the highest score overall by the highest score of the sub, and then multiply the scores of posts in that sub by that number. In our example, it would multiply the scores of the super-popular sub by 1, the moderate sub by 10, and the oddball by 100. Then it would just display the front page in order of the scores of the various posts mutliplied by their sub's conversion factor. If an oddball sub post had 7 upvoats, it would be displayed in front of a post from the super popular sub with 682 upvoats, but behind a post from the moderately popular sub with 83 upvoats.

Of course, that would have to be calculated client-side, I can't see the server being able to handle the load of generating those numbers for every member's distinct set of subscribed subs.

The main thing that is unhealthy about soda is the sugars/carbohydrates because of the extreme amounts in it. Assuming you have a healthy liver, a can of beer will not have enough alcohol do really do serious damage unless you're downing the whole thing in one go. In this case, a can of beer a day would be "healthier" than a can of soda.

In terms of drinking large quantities, if you're doing this over the course of a day then in the long run the cans of beer would be "healthier" than the cans of soda. However in the case of binge drinking and just downing the drinks in one sitting, the beer may lead to liver damage and doing this over the course of a few weeks may result in liver damage. In this case, the cans of soda are "healthier" than the cans of beer.

Finally, please do not binge drink and have everything in moderation.
